sets.relationshipLabel: whole travel vehicle necessarily contains this key structural/functional part
sets.explanation: An airplane always has a cockpit and a ship always has a hull — each vehicle necessarily includes this defining structural component.

sets.relationshipLabel: raw material becomes a structural travel-vehicle component
sets.explanation: Rubber is shaped into a tire and steel is rolled into rail — each raw material becomes a load-bearing part of a transport system.

sets.relationshipLabel: travel-sense noun maps to its synonym meaning a role or agreement
sets.explanation: A charter is also a contract and a berth is also a position — each travel term hides a synonym describing an agreement or role.

sets.relationshipLabel: travel-sense word becomes the modifying word in a familiar compound phrase
sets.explanation: Flight becomes 'flight of stairs' and terminal becomes 'terminal illness' — each travel word slides into a completely different familiar phrase.
